rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive construction for something located on an upper floor, as in 樓上嘅房間.

example.english: The upstairs bathroom is being renovated.
example.jyutping: lau4 soeng6 ge3 ci3 so2 zing2 gan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an upper floor, such as in “an upstairs bathroom.”
This is the all-purpose spoken equivalent for being on or going to a higher floor.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 lau4 soeng6 dang2 nei5

rows.note: Use this only for the figurative sense of something being in a person's head or mind, not for a higher floor.

example.english: The answer is still upstairs in my head; I just can’t think of it.
example.traditional: 個答案仲喺個腦入面，我未諗到。
example.jyutping: go3 daap3 on3 zung6 hai2 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 ngo5 mei6 nam2 dou2
